chapter: Chords, recordings and his own groups
title: Don Byas and the Barron
summary: He worked across the street from Don Byas and later at the Barron, where George Benson sat in.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Did you know Don Byas well?

...We worked across the street from each other -- When he was in town a few years ago I was playing at a place called the Barron ... on Lenox Avenue and 134, 135th ... it was a heck of a club, there. We had all the big musicians, even George Benson used to come down there and play with me. He's a good friend....
